title: The discrete logarithm problem in cokernels of $\mathcal{O}_K$-matrices
summary: In 2009 and 2010, Blackburn and Shokrieh independently found that the discrete logarithm can be computed efficiently on the sandpile group of a graph, meaning that sandpile groups are not secure for cryptography. We generalize this problem to cokernels of matrices with entries in the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$ of a number field $K$. When $K$ has nontrivial class group, the failure of the Euclidean algorithm in $\mathcal{O}_K$ is an obstacle to generalizing previous methods.
